name: delete
description: 删除文件或目录。默认送回收站（trash=true，可恢复7天），force=true 且 trash=false 时永久硬删除（删除前自动备份：文件用哈希内容寻址备份，目录用 tar.gz 整体归档，均支持 undo 恢复）。支持批量（paths 数组）与预演模式（dryRun）。安全校验：路径越权、symlink 遍历、Windows 路径折叠、dev vault（.git）防护、read-before-delete。此操作具有破坏性。
description_en: Delete files or directories. Defaults to moving to the recycle bin (trash=true, recoverable for 7 days); with force=true and trash=false performs a permanent hard delete (automatic backup before deletion: hash content-addressed backup for files, tar.gz archive for directories, both undo-recoverable). Supports batching (paths array) and dry-run. Safety checks: path escapes, symlink traversal, Windows path folding, dev vault (.git) protection, read-before-delete. This operation is destructive.

path.description: 要删除的文件或目录的绝对或相对路径（单路径模式，与 paths 互斥）
path.description_en: Absolute or relative path of the file or directory to delete (single-path mode, mutually exclusive with paths)

paths.description: 批量删除的路径数组（多路径模式，与 path 互斥）
paths.description_en: Array of paths to delete in batch (multi-path mode, mutually exclusive with path)

recursive.description: 删除目录时必填。递归删除目录树。对文件忽略
recursive.description_en: Required when deleting a directory. Recursively deletes the directory tree. Ignored for files

trash.description: 默认 true 送回收站（可恢复7天）。设为 false 且 force=true 时永久硬删除
trash.description_en: Defaults to true: move to recycle bin (recoverable for 7 days). Set to false with force=true for permanent hard delete

force.description: 强制模式：跳过 read-before-delete 与 dev vault 防护，rmSync 用 force 覆盖只读文件。仅与 trash=false 配合生效
force.description_en: Force mode: skips read-before-delete and dev vault protection; rmSync uses force to override read-only files. Only effective together with trash=false

dryRun.description: 预演模式：返回将被删除的路径清单与总大小，不执行任何删除操作
dryRun.description_en: Dry-run mode: returns the list of paths that would be deleted and their total size without deleting anything
